checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does process_proposer_lookahead shift exactly SLOTS_PER_EPOCH entries from the front of the proposer_lookahead array?

reachability.notes: An off-by-one in the shift amount would leave stale entries at the front or remove entries for the current epoch, causing proposer assignment errors.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Locate the process_proposer_lookahead function and identify the array shift operation. 2. Verify the shift index calculation: confirm state.proposer_lookahead[:last_epoch_start] = state.proposer_lookahead[SLOTS_PER_EPOCH:] where last_epoch_start = len(state.proposer_lookahead) - SLOTS_PER_EPOCH. 3. Test with boundary conditions: verify behavior when array length equals exactly SLOTS_PER_EPOCH, 2*SLOTS_PER_EPOCH, and edge cases. 4. Attempt to falsify: inject SLOTS_PER_EPOCH - 1 or SLOTS_PER_EPOCH + 1 as shift amount and verify detection of stale entries or array underflow. 5. Verify proposer assignments after shift operation match expected validators for current epoch. 6. Check for any hardcoded values that should reference SLOTS_PER_EPOCH constant.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0042, Trust Boundary: tb-009, Invariant: FULU-SG008-INV-001, Threat: stride-011. Shifting by SLOTS_PER_EPOCH - 1 would leave one stale entry, causing the proposer for one slot to be from a previous epoch. Shifting by SLOTS_PER_EPOCH + 1 would remove a valid entry, causing an array underflow or missing proposer.

checklist.title: Verify Consensus Layer Node Integrity: Are proposer lookahead updates correctly propagated within the consensus layer?

reachability.notes: Supporting check for consensus layer node involvement in proposer lookahead processing.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Trace the data flow from process_proposer_lookahead to consensus layer components (actor-consensus-layer). 2. Verify that shifted proposer lookahead state is correctly consumed by consensus mechanisms. 3. Check for race conditions or stale reads of proposer_lookahead during epoch transitions. 4. Verify consensus layer correctly handles the reduced array size after shift.

checklist.title: Verify Validator Node Integrity: Are validators correctly assigned based on shifted proposer lookahead?

reachability.notes: Supporting check for validator node involvement in proposer assignments.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Verify that validator proposer assignments reference correct indices after the shift operation. 2. Check that no validator receives proposer duties based on stale lookahead entries. 3. Test epoch boundary transitions to ensure validator duties update correctly. 4. Verify no validator is skipped or double-assigned due to shift miscalculation.
